description: Human-readable join contract for cover-letter fill. fill_cover_letter.py discovers {{TOKENS}} in locked-cover-letter-template.docx, binds locked contact fields by naming convention, and overlays sandbox tailored-cover-letter.md section blocks (ADR-053). This file is documentation, not a nested cover-letter instance.
core_themes_source: ANALYSIS.core_themes copied onto *-tailor-request.json and minted into engineering-log.md. Resume-tailor resolves nested skill/strength/hook slots from that log, not by re-researching.

abort_rules: Abort if locked-contact.json or required contact fields are missing.
Abort if tailored-cover-letter.md is missing required sections Opener, Body 1, Body 2, Call to Action, Closing.
Abort if a template token names an unknown object or field.
Abort if any {{ remains after fill.
Never write to .ai/guardrails/ during a normal resume-tailor run.

nested_slots.notes: Resolved by the resume-tailor agent into tailored-cover-letter.md prose before fill. The Word filler does not expand JOB_SKILL_* or STRENGTH_* inside section blocks.

token_grammar.locked_contact: {{CONTACT_FULL_NAME}} is first_name plus last_name. Other CONTACT_* tokens bind like fill_resume.py.

runtime.CURRENT_DATE: Date line from tailored-cover-letter.md, else UTC today long form.
runtime.JOB_ID: sandbox job-id.txt source_job_id suffix when present.
runtime.REF_NUM: Alias of JOB_ID for requisition placeholders.
